INTAKE.IDENTITY.description: Stable business identity must be present and unique within the supplied batch.

INTAKE.REQUIRED.description: Vendor ID and invoice number are required invoice header fields.

INTAKE.AMOUNT.description: Invoice amount must be an explicit finite Decimal-compatible number.

INTAKE.CURRENCY.description: Invoice currency must be an explicit uppercase three-letter code; this is not an ISO registry lookup.

INTAKE.DATE.description: Invoice date must be an explicit valid ISO date or ISO datetime.

MATCH.LINE_LINK.description: Each sourced invoice line requires an exact invoice/PO/PO-line link, quantity, price, UOM and currency; the PO line must be unique.

MATCH.PRICE.description: Compare Decimal unit prices only in comparable units and currencies. Supplied batches need explicit sourced production_price_tolerance. Only SYNTHETIC_DEMO MYR permits configured demo_myr_rounding_allowance of exactly 0.02.

MATCH.QUANTITY.description: Aggregate billed quantity per invoice and PO line against dated net receipts less other invoices' prior allocations, with zero quantity tolerance. Sourced policy must attest allocations_complete and returns_complete as true.

MATCH.BATCH_CAPACITY.description: Evaluate dated competing batch demand without inventing allocations. Overcapacity is FAIL with INFERRED_CANDIDATE evidence, not an allocation decision.

MATCH.TAX.description: Require explicit invoice tax_code, tax_rate, tax_amount and net_amount and a unique company/currency/code tax rule with tax_rate and inclusive effective_from/effective_to. Rates are fractions; arithmetic is exact with no inferred rounding.

MATCH.FX.description: Foreign-currency line prices require unique sourced fx_rates with from_currency, to_currency, rate and rate_date matching invoice_date. No inverse or fallback rate is inferred.

FRAUD.DUPLICATE.description: Exact vendor/invoice-number/currency/company duplicates with different invoice IDs are duplicate records, not proven fraud. Negative results cover only the supplied batch.

FRAUD.SIMILAR.description: Same vendor, Decimal amount, currency and date across different invoice IDs is an inferred review candidate, not confirmed fraud or an inferred PO link.

FRAUD.BANK_MATCH.description: Present vendor/invoice bank_account discrepancies are risk signals. Equality can PASS only with independent verification. Findings never contain raw bank values.

FRAUD.BANK_VERIFICATION.description: Require a unique vendor bank verification with verified=true, independent=true and a source_ref distinct from invoice and vendor source references.

ACCOUNTING.GL.description: Require a unique gl_account/company_code master record with explicit active=true.

ACCOUNTING.APPROVAL.description: Require a unique actual invoice approval_decision and exact approver/currency/company authority effective on decision_date. APPROVED passes only at or below inclusive max_amount; REJECTED fails. Authority alone never proves approval.

ACCOUNTING.TAX.description: Use only supplied dated company/currency/tax-code rules and explicit invoice tax_rate, tax_amount and net_amount. Rates are fractions and calculations are exact.

ACCOUNTING.FX.description: Require explicit accounting_currency; same currency is NOT_APPLICABLE. Otherwise compare explicit accounting_amount with amount times a unique sourced direct rate dated invoice_date. No invented converted amounts or rounding.
